decision.rationale: The public UBC Master of Food and Resource Economics homepage explains a one-year graduate program, courses, concentrations, faculty, professional skills and applications. It provides useful academic information without an exclusively Okanagan mandate. Explicit careers, event participation and contact assistance override the academic host purpose.
